assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target image 1: blank woodland game popup board. Supporting style image 2: approved inventory mockup. Create ONLY the blank outer inventory wood board asset, not a populated UI screenshot. Match the calm thin wooden frame and warm restrained brass edging of image 2, at landscape 1.76:1 ratio. Keep the decoration identities from image 1 exactly in the same cartoon family: thick dark-brown outlines, plump bright lime leaf veins, round shiny orange mushroom caps with cream stems lower left, sharp faceted cyan crystals among lime leaves lower right. The image 2 decorations are NOT the reference for species or shape. Upper-left leaves and the two lower corner clusters should be modest size, each cluster occupying no more than 11% board width and 16% height; keep the original asymmetry. The wood face is empty and uninterrupted medium warm brown fine horizontal grain. Thin wood outer rail, slim muted honey brass inset line, very restrained yellow highlights. No wide bright gold rail. No title plaque, text, icons, slots, characters or buttons. Clean orthographic frontal asset, actual transparent outside rounded board and foliage. Board nearly fills canvas with very small transparent safety margin.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable square 9-slice UI recessed wooden panel for woodland inventory, actual transparent outside. Style reference image 2 approved inventory concept, image 1 original popup wood materials. Single centered square panel, nearly fills square canvas. Medium dark warm-brown wood face with subtle horizontal grain, shallow inset rim, rounded subtly clipped corners, hand-painted maple cartoon rendering with dark-brown outlines. Frame is natural carved golden-brown wood with one very fine muted honey brass line, NOT a bright gold metal frame. Uniform borders only about 5% width, uninterrupted blank center suitable for stretching to portrait panel and large inventory grid backing. No leaves, no mushrooms, no crystals, no studs crossing the corners, no label, text, glyph, character, icon or slots. One single UI asset, no sheet, no mockup. Carefully maintain symmetrical top/bottom/left/right edge widths for nine slicing.
